subject: Billing setup: portal enrollment, PO placement, and legal remit details
messages:
From: Susan Kellogg <susan.kellogg@brightlane.co>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: ap@brightlane.co
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: Billing setup — preferred delivery and PO placement

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for taking this. Our AP team is preparing to onboard Redwood and we have a couple of questions to make sure invoices process cleanly on our side:  

- Do you support portal delivery with an API/SFTP push, or do you primarily send PDFs by email?
- If we opt for portal + email copies, can the invoice subject or filename include the PO number so our AP auto-ingest rules match?
- Legal remit name and tax ID — can you confirm the name to appear on the invoice and whether you can provide a completed W-9?

I've attached our sample PO format for reference. If portal is available, we'd prefer that but need the email PDF copy sent to ap@brightlane.co for manual handoff during the pilot.

Appreciate a short checklist so we can slot this into our onboarding calendar.

Thanks,
Susan Kellogg
Accounts Payable Manager
BrightLane Health
Attachment: brightlane_sample_po.pdf (pdf, 21KB)
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Kellogg <susan.kellogg@brightlane.co>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ap@brightlane.co
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Billing setup — preferred delivery and PO placement

Hi Susan — great to meet you over email. Short answers up front: portal with email copies is supported, and we can include PO identifiers in the filename and subject for easier ingestion. W-9 is available and I can attach that in my next message.

Suggested minimal onboarding checklist:  
1) Confirm billing contact + email we should CC on each invoice.
2) Share sample PO format (thanks for attaching).
3) Decide filename/subject pattern (we can do "Redwood_Invoice_<INVOICE>#_PO_<PO#>" by default).
4) Provide legal remit name + Tax ID for invoice header.
5) Optional: enable SFTP push or portal API for future automation.

I've looped in Kimberly Park from Payments/Integrations — she'll own the AP integration and will reach out with the portal onboarding link and a short tech checklist (SFTP creds, firewall allowlist, sample schema).

For the pilot we'll send both: portal as primary and email PDF to ap@brightlane.co (and any additional CC you specify). If that works, we'll lock the pattern and start sending the next invoice in the agreed subject format.

Best,
Priyom Das
Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, Inc.

- PO numbers: BrightLane uses a 9-digit numeric PO (e.g., 000123456). If you can include only the numeric PO in subject/filename that is ideal.
- Legal remit: "BrightLane Health, Inc." (we'll confirm Tax ID separately if needed).
- W-9: can you send the completed form to my attention? We need it for our vendor setup.

Also, can you send a two-line mutual action plan (owner + ETA) so I can schedule the vendor setup in our system? We usually allow 5 business days for AP setup once we receive documents.

Appreciate it — Susan
